# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Utility for safely rendering a user‑submitted blog entry. """ import html from typing import Final # Predefined template – uses {title} and {body} placeholders. BLOG_FORMAT: Final[str] = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(heading: str, content: str) -> str: """ Render a blog entry safely for HTML output. Parameters ---------- heading : str The title of the blog post. content : str The main text body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A fully formatted, HTML‑escaped string ready for display. Notes ----- * All user input is escaped with :func:`html.escape` to prevent XSS. * The function does **not** perform any additional sanitisation beyond escaping; if richer sanitisation is required (e.g. stripping tags), a dedicated library such as `bleach` should be used. """ # Escape user‑supplied data to neutralise HTML special characters. safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Format the blog post with the sanitized values. formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
